column1: # OLMoE-1B-7B: downstream cost of imposing rolling residency at R=8 of 64 (12.5% resident) with NO adaptation, gate_mass=preserve. 'preserve' selects the top-k from the masked distribution but takes weights from the unmasked one, so residency changes which experts serve and not how much they contribute; 'renorm' is the published behaviour, which on this norm_topk_prob=False model also rescales gate mass ~0.40 -> 1.0 and accounts for 91.6% of the measured BPB damage. Ten 0-shot tasks, same harness as olmoe_adapt_downstream.csv. Producer: analysis/residency/olmoe_downstream_naive.py
